analyses.content: 录音中房东明确说房子打扫完后在5月5日（5th of May）可以入住。
你容易听到前任租客的到期日“5月3日（May 3rd）”就直接写上，没听到后面说还要打扫一天才空出来。

Anyway, could you tell me the exact date when you can move in? Well, the contract with my current tenant is due next week on May 3rd, and I need a day to clean and check the things in the house, so I think the house will be ready on the 5th of May. Is that okay?
录音中房东明确说明租金总共是1700美元（seventeen hundred dollars）。
你容易把学生说的预算500美元（five hundred）或最高承受限度600美元（six hundred）当成最终的实际租金。

And what we're most concerned about is the rent. We'd like something around five hundred dollars a month for each of us, but we could go up to six hundred dollars if we have to, but we can't go beyond that. You are lucky. The rent will be seventeen hundred dollars in total, which is within your budget.
录音中房东说你需要提供信用检查（credit check），这项费用刚好对应题目中的15美元。
你可能只注意到了数字15美元，但往前漏听了这项收费的具体名称是credit check。
Oh, I nearly forgot. One important thing is that you'll be required to provide a credit check to guarantee your ability to pay the rent every month. This will charge you fifteen dollars.
录音中提到共享厨房（kitchen）在几个月前翻新过，完美对应题目里的remodelled。
如果你不知道录音里的refurbished和题目的remodelled是同义替换，就会完全错失答案kitchen。
First, there are three bedrooms combined with two bathrooms. Then, there is a shared kitchen which was refurbished several months ago.
录音中房东说如果你想要洗碗机（dishwasher），需要以后自己加，说明房子里现在没有。
你可能会把学生提问的厨具（cookers）当成答案，但房东明确回答做饭基本设施是有的，缺的只是dishwasher。
Do we have to buy our own cookers? Basic facilities for cooking are available, but if you want a dishwasher, I'm sorry, it needs to be added later.
录音中房东说车库（garage）里不仅能停车，还有一个可以用来工作（work）的特殊区域。
如果你的注意力只放在了“停车”上，没抓取到具体回答的建筑名词garage，就会漏填答案。

Is there any place we can park, as one of my friends has a private car? Yes. There is a garage which not only provides space for your car, but also has a special section where you can do some of your work. It's very quiet for you to concentrate.
录音中明确指出虽然有园丁负责景观，但你需要帮忙每周给草地浇水（water the grass）。
你可能只把water当成名词“水”，没反应过来在这里它是动词“浇水”的意思，导致觉得语法不通而不敢填。

Do we have to take care of these plants and flowers? Well, you don't have to worry about that. There will be a professional gardener to do the landscaping in the garden regularly, but you do need to help water the grass once a week. Is it a problem for you?
录音提到这项每月15美元的清洁服务负责清理垃圾（rubbish，对应trashing）和回收（recycling）。
你可能一听到“清理垃圾（rubbish）”就觉得信息结束了，从而忽略了紧跟在后面的并列信息recycling。
Another thing is in this district, every household is arranged with a cleaner responsible for cleaning up the rubbish and recycling, but this service will cost you fifteen dollars every month.
录音说明虽然没有中央空调，但每个房间的窗户（window）上都安装了空调设备。
题目将录音里的“安装在窗户上（installed on the window）”改成了前置修饰语“窗户空调设备”，如果只等原词出现会反应不过来。
Is air conditioning available in the house? If you mean central air conditioning, I'm afraid there isn't at the moment, but each room has a conditioning unit which is installed on the window.
录音中直接完整拼读了名字Sam后面的姓氏D-R-E-S-S-L-E-R。
遇到这种单纯的拼写题，你最容易在双写字母（double S）或者相近发音的元音字母上出现听写失误。
May I have your name and phone number? Yes. I'm Sam Dressler. That's S-A-M D-R-E-S-S-L-E-R.
